enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed on back. Eyes closed. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up to chin. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Move arm under pillow. Sigh. Turn to back. Kick off blanket. Pull blanket back. Scratch leg. Turn to left side. Remain still.

Turn on bathroom light. Use toilet. Flush toilet. Wash hands with soap. Rinse hands. Dry hands with towel. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe face with towel. Turn off bathroom light.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk and eggs. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard. Take out bowl and cereal box. Close cupboard. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Place bowl on table. Sit on chair. Eat cereal with spoon.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing work bag
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt and pants. Close wardrobe. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Open drawer. Take out work bag. Close drawer. Put phone in bag.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Check phone for time. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk to hospital entrance. Enter hospital. Walk to locker room. Change into scrubs.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, caring for patients and updating clinical records
enriched_activities.desc: Attend morning meeting. Review patient list. Visit patient room 1. Check vital signs. Administer medication. Update records on computer. Visit patient room 2. Assist with dressing change. Talk to patient. Update records. Take lunch break. Eat lunch in cafeteria. Return to ward. Visit patient room 3. Check IV drip. Update records. Attend afternoon meeting. Review test results. Update clinical notes. Hand over to next shift.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter house. Take off shoes. Hang up coat.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and changing out of work clothes
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on water heater. Remove work clothes. Place clothes in hamper. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Wash body with soap. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out of shower. Dry with towel. Put on clean clothes.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Add meat. Cook. Turn off stove. Put food on plate. Sit at table. Eat with fork. Drink water. Clear table. Wash dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Loading the washing machine for laundry
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Open washing machine. Put dirty clothes in. Close washing machine. Open detergent drawer. Add detergent. Close detergent drawer. Press start button. Set timer. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa watching TV and browsing on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Pick up laptop. Open laptop. Browse internet. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Watch TV. Pick up remote. Change channel. Pick up laptop. Browse internet. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Close laptop. Stand up.
Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Use toilet. Flush toilet. Wash hands with soap. Rinse hands. Dry hands. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off light.

Lie in bed on back. Pull blanket up. Close eyes. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Move arm. Sigh. Turn to back. Kick off blanket. Pull blanket back. Scratch leg. Turn to left side. Remain still.
